**Mi Band 7 / 8 / 9:** use `mi-band-192x490.png` as the background and put the clock inside
the screen: x 35, y 106, 123 × 154 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.4287 (spec 0.4216), screen at the exact 128:160 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:T630_Beax.png (ruler cropped off)), see Commons page; geometry measured on a [photo](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:T630_Beax.png); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/t630/).
